sentences.en: Kim means to be a diplomat in the future.
sentences.zh: 金将来想成为一名外交官。

sentences.en: He has spent most of his working life as a diplomat.
sentences.zh: 他一生中的大部分时间都在从事外交工作。

sentences.en: He was a famous poet and a competent diplomat.
sentences.zh: 他是一位著名的诗人兼称职的外交官。

senses.zh: 外交官,有外交手腕的人,善于交际的人,处事圆滑机敏的人
